title: Yuu Echo Relic
description: Relic drop and activation system for hostile mob grinding.
body:
# Yuu Echo Relic

Relic drop and activation system for hostile mob grinding.

## Features
- Hostile mobs can drop custom Echo Relic items.
- Right-click relic activation grants a random temporary buff.
- Per-player relic discovery tracking in data.yml.
- Simple progression layer for PvE servers.

## Command
- `/relicinfo [player|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuuechorelic.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
